text.card: A red giant 1,798 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.00 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,689 K at its surface.
